title: nauclea zeylanica
intro: Nauclea zeylanica, commonly known as Quinine Tree, is a plant species native to Southeast Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including the treatment of fever, malaria, and other infectious diseases, due to its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Nauclea zeylanica include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain and inflammation, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as quinine, naucleaphenone, and other alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
